english.title: Parent fail to comply with a notice to present pupil for medical examination
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the parent of a pupil, namely **(..SPECIFY PUPIL..), at **(..SPECIFY EDUCATIONAL ESTABLISHMENT..), failed without reasonable excuse to comply with a notice served on you in accordance with section 506(1) of the Education Act 1996 on **(..SPECIFY DATE OF SERVICE..) requiring you to present that pupil for examination by a registered medical practitioner
english.legislation: Contrary to section 506(2) and (3) of the Education Act 1996.
